notes: Reviewed procedures, procedure slots, and the roles those slots need, for equipment the protected workbook has no rows for. Applied by scripts/ip-preference-cards/apply-procedure-additions.ts: roles before the product merge so a product may claim one, procedures and slots after it so a slot option may reference an added product, and both before the reviewed remediation overlays so a review correction can still retarget anything added here. Every entry carries its own reason and every rule in the applicator is a hard import error rather than a silent skip. No exact slot options are authored: an option is a clinician-reviewed statement that a specific product belongs in a specific slot, and none of these slots has been through that review, so the proposal generator surfaces non-selectable candidates instead.

rolesToAdd.description: Footswitch, cart, mounting set, or other accessory belonging to a named electrosurgical or argon plasma platform.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match the exact generator model and its mounting configuration; a footswitch is generation-specific and does not transfer between platforms.
rolesToAdd.reason: The generator itself was catalogued with no way to record the footswitch a room actually needs.

rolesToAdd.description: Generator and system delivering short high-voltage pulses for non-thermal tissue ablation.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Confirm the cleared indication before selecting: US clearance in this category is for surgical ablation of soft tissue, not for an airway indication. Match the generator to its own single-use electrode.
rolesToAdd.reason: Pulsed electric field is one of the two most actively developed bronchoscopic ablation modalities and had no role at all.

rolesToAdd.description: Single-use needle or catheter electrode used with a pulsed electric field generator.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Restrict selection to the electrode the generator manufacturer names; confirm the cleared indication and the current IFU.
rolesToAdd.reason: Pairs with PULSED_FIELD_ABLATION_SYSTEM so the generator and its electrode are separate line items.

rolesToAdd.description: Flexible microwave antenna delivered bronchoscopically to ablate a peripheral lung lesion.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Every device in this category is investigational in the United States; confirm study enrolment and regulatory status before planning a case around one.
rolesToAdd.reason: The bronchoscopic tumour-ablation card names microwave as a modality; without the role the slot could not exist even as a placeholder.

rolesToAdd.description: Monopolar hook, button, or dissection electrode passed through the thoracoscope working channel.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Match shaft diameter and working length to the telescope channel, and confirm the generator, waveform, power setting, and return electrode against the current IFU — sell sheets state none of these.
rolesToAdd.reason: Medical thoracoscopy had no energy requirement at all, in a procedure where adhesiolysis and surface haemostasis are routine.

rolesToAdd.description: Laser generator used for endobronchial photoresection — deep coagulation and devascularization before debulking, vaporization of exophytic tissue, and precise cutting of webs and strictures.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Wavelength decides tissue effect, and the choice is between depth and precision. Nd:YAG 1064 nm penetrates 5-15 mm and is the airway workhorse: poorly absorbed by water and haemoglobin, so it coagulates deeply and devascularizes a tumour before debulking, at 20-40 W. Nd:YAP 1340 nm penetrates 3-10 mm at about 20 W. Diode 980 nm penetrates 2-4 mm at about 20 W and 1470 nm penetrates 2-3 mm at about 10 W, both compact and air-cooled. KTP 532 nm and Ho:YAG 2100 nm penetrate under 1 mm and cut rather than coagulate — KTP at 15-35 W is what to reach for to incise a web-like stricture before dilation. CO2 10,600 nm penetrates under 1 mm at 4-8 W and is preferred for laryngeal and subglottic strictures, where precise cutting matters and deep haemostasis does not. Nd:YAG availability in the United States is now limited, and mobile laser service is how many centres reach Nd:YAG, KTP, and Ho:YAG at all — the catalogued consoles for those three wavelengths are all mobile-service offerings, and each records how far its own paperwork actually goes. Every product carries its lasing medium where a source states one.
rolesToAdd.reason: Laser had no role of any kind despite being standard equipment for central airway obstruction.

rolesToAdd.description: Bare, cooled, or hollow-core fibre carrying the laser beam through the working channel. An optical fibre delivery system is the only one a bronchoscope channel can accommodate.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: The fibre has to be made for the console wavelength — CO2 needs a hollow-core waveguide, the near-infrared wavelengths run on quartz. Contact with a bare fibre cuts; non-contact with an air-cooled catheter coagulates over a wider area, avoids the tip fouling with debris and blood, and is the mode to use for haemostasis. Power density is set as much by distance as by watts: close and high-power carbonizes and vaporizes, farther and low-power coagulates broadly, and most operators start low to coagulate the tumour before debulking. Check core diameter against the working channel, and keep the tip clean.
rolesToAdd.reason: The console alone does not describe what is passed down the scope.

rolesToAdd.description: Wavelength-specific protective eyewear, room signage and window covering, system filter units, and the fire-prevention materials a laser case requires.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Eyewear is specific to the laser and is not interchangeable between systems — protection at one wavelength gives none at another, so the eyewear that comes with the console is the eyewear the room wears, and everyone inside the nominal hazard zone wears it. Airway lasers are class 3B or 4. Cover door and window signage, wet drapes or towels around the site, sterile water or saline within reach, no alcohol-based prep, no hairspray or oil-based lubricants on team or patient, and a gown, gloves, and face shield for the operator.
rolesToAdd.reason: Laser safety is a room requirement, not an optional accessory, and nothing recorded it.

rolesToAdd.description: Endotracheal tube constructed to resist ignition when a laser is fired in the airway, with a cuff filled with saline or water rather than air.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: A standard endotracheal tube is not recommended when a laser will be fired in the airway: it is a flammable fuel source sitting in an oxidizer-rich field. Select a laser-resistant tube matched to the wavelength in use — resistance is not universal across wavelengths — and fill the cuff with saline or water so a cuff strike floods rather than feeds the fire. This is separate from the airway a rigid case uses, and it is the requirement whenever laser is applied through or beside an indwelling tube or tracheostomy.
rolesToAdd.reason: The literature is explicit that a standard endotracheal tube should not be used during airway laser work, and nothing in the catalog recorded the alternative.

rolesToAdd.description: Systemically administered photosensitizing drug activated by light at a specific wavelength.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Dose by weight and record the administration time: light activation follows at a defined interval, and the interval is part of the therapy rather than scheduling convenience. Counsel on prolonged cutaneous photosensitivity.
rolesToAdd.reason: Photodynamic therapy is a staged workflow with a drug as its first line item; the precedent is the talc vial.

rolesToAdd.description: Laser delivering the narrow activation wavelength the photosensitizer requires.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Wavelength tolerance is narrow and is part of the labelling, not a preference. A red laser with different output characteristics can under-activate, overtreat, injure normal tissue, or damage the fibre.
rolesToAdd.reason: The activation laser is not interchangeable with the debulking laser and needs its own line.

rolesToAdd.description: Cylindrical diffuser fibre passed through the working channel to deliver activation light along the lesion.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Choose the diffuser length to cover the lesion while sparing normal mucosa, and avoid overlapping treatments that would overdose normal bronchial mucosa. Diffuser length sets the delivered power at a fixed fluence.
rolesToAdd.reason: Diffuser length is the dosimetry decision in endobronchial photodynamic therapy.

rolesToAdd.description: Mobile C-arm providing 2D fluoroscopy and, on 3D-capable systems, cone-beam acquisition.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Confirm the room can accommodate the system and that 3D acquisition is available if the plan depends on it. Identity only is recorded here — no dose, detector, or image-quality claim is carried from a marketing brochure.
rolesToAdd.reason: Fluoroscopy existed only as a modifier and a room-capability string, so a card could never name the system it needed.

rolesToAdd.description: Augmented-fluoroscopy platform reconstructing intraprocedural tomosynthesis to localize peripheral lesions and confirm tool-in-lesion.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Confirm C-arm compatibility and whether a per-procedure kit is required. These platforms supplement rather than replace the navigation modality already recorded for the case.
rolesToAdd.reason: Peripheral navigation had platform roles but nothing for intraprocedural tomosynthesis confirmation.

rolesToAdd.description: Lead aprons, thyroid shields, leaded eyewear, shields, and dosimetry for everyone in the room during fluoroscopy.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Sized per person and worn by every person in the room, not only the operator. Catalogued products are hospital-local, so this is normally recorded as a custom line describing what the room stocks.
rolesToAdd.reason: Bringing a C-arm into the room creates an occupational-exposure requirement that nothing recorded.

rolesToAdd.description: Sterile saline stocked and warmed for whole lung lavage.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Plan 30 to 50 L per lung in 3 L bags, warmed to body temperature before instillation. Confirm the stock actually on hand: this is far more volume than a routine case, and running short mid-lavage is the failure mode.
rolesToAdd.reason: The whole lavage setup was one opaque line; volume and temperature are the first two decisions.

rolesToAdd.description: Irrigation-solution warmer or blood warmer holding the lavage fluid at body temperature.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Confirm the warmer can sustain the flow rate rather than only reach the temperature; instilling cool fluid causes shivering, bronchospasm, and heat loss across tens of litres.
rolesToAdd.reason: Warming is a separate device from the saline itself and from the circuit.

rolesToAdd.description: Manual percussion, mechanical percussor, or high-frequency chest wall oscillation vest used between fill and drain cycles.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Confirm what the unit stocks and who applies it. Percussion during dwell is what mobilizes proteinaceous material into the effluent, so it is part of the therapy rather than an adjunct.
rolesToAdd.reason: Percussion is a named step of the technique with no line item.

rolesToAdd.description: Graduated containers or canisters for measuring and inspecting the drained lavage effluent.
rolesToAdd.selection_guidance: Graduated so input and output can be reconciled each cycle, and clear enough to judge when the effluent stops clearing — both are how the endpoint is called.
rolesToAdd.reason: Fluid balance and effluent clearing are the two things the operator watches; neither had a line.

proceduresToAdd.notes: A staged workflow rather than a modifier: photosensitizer on day one, light activation at a defined interval, and a mandatory debridement bronchoscopy after that. The sections mirror those stages.
proceduresToAdd.reason: Photodynamic therapy spans three separate encounters with different equipment in each; no modifier on an existing card can express that.

proceduresToAdd.notes: One comparative card across the ablation modalities. Cryo, APC, and laser carry real catalog content; microwave and pulsed electric field are named as conditional slots with no selectable product, because every bronchoscopic device in those two categories is investigational in the United States. See /preference-cards/emerging.
proceduresToAdd.reason: The ablation modalities were scattered across other cards or absent entirely, and the investigational ones had nowhere to be named honestly.

slotsToAdd.generic_requirement: Monopolar hook, button, or dissection electrode matched to the telescope working channel.
slotsToAdd.reason: Medical thoracoscopy carried no energy requirement despite routine adhesiolysis and surface haemostasis.

slotsToAdd.generic_requirement: Generator and return electrode compatible with the selected thoracoscopy electrode.
slotsToAdd.reason: An electrode with no generator recorded is an incomplete requirement.

slotsToAdd.generic_requirement: Laser generator matched to the intended tissue effect. Nd:YAG 1064 nm at 20-40 W is the airway workhorse for deep coagulation before debulking; KTP 532 nm at 15-35 W cuts a web-like stricture before dilation; CO2 for laryngeal and subglottic work.
slotsToAdd.notes: Mehta’s rule of 4, for a flexible-bronchoscopy laser case: lesion no longer than 4 cm, lung collapsed under 4 weeks, life expectancy over 4 weeks, procedure under 4 hours, FiO2 under 40%, under 40 pulses between fibre cleanings, no more than 4 repeat treatments, a team of 4, and initial settings of 40 W non-contact or 4 W contact at 0.4 s. Sustained power above 40 W or pulses longer than 1 s are the reported risk factors for perforation.
slotsToAdd.reason: Laser had no role or slot despite being standard for central airway obstruction.

slotsToAdd.generic_requirement: Fibre made for the console wavelength. Contact with a bare fibre to cut; non-contact with an air-cooled catheter to coagulate and to keep the tip clean.
slotsToAdd.notes: Distances that matter: the fibre protrudes at least 4 mm beyond the working channel, sits about 4 mm from the lesion, and the tube stays more than 4 cm back from it. Keep coolant airflow low and avoid direct probe-to-tissue contact — air embolism has been attributed to high coolant flow.
slotsToAdd.reason: The console alone does not describe what is passed down the scope.

slotsToAdd.generic_requirement: Wavelength-matched eyewear for everyone in the nominal hazard zone, door and window signage, wet drapes, sterile water or saline within reach, and any filter unit the console requires.
slotsToAdd.notes: Eyewear is not interchangeable between laser systems. Plan a second suction line: one for the bronchoscope and one for the mouth, to clear blood, secretions, and the laser plume. Human papillomavirus transmission through surgical plume has been documented, so in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis optimize suction, minimize laser use, and consider cryotherapy instead.
slotsToAdd.reason: Laser safety is a room requirement whenever the console is in the room.

slotsToAdd.generic_requirement: Laser-resistant tube matched to the wavelength in use, with the cuff filled with saline or water rather than air.
slotsToAdd.dependency_rule: Laser planned with an indwelling tube or tracheostomy
slotsToAdd.notes: A standard endotracheal tube is not recommended when a laser is fired in the airway. FiO2 and FeO2 both stay at or below 40% while the beam is on.
slotsToAdd.reason: The literature is explicit that a standard tube should not be in the airway during laser work; the alternative had no line item.
